runs: When you update the email address attached to your account, we’ll send you an email asking you to confirm the change. In the email we send, clicking the
button lets us know the email address is yours.
Log in to the email inbox for the address you just updated.
Open the email from >x< inviting you to confirm your account.
Tap the
button in that email.
We’ll direct you to your >x< account, and if you are not already logged in we'll ask you to do so.

If you do not complete the confirmation process above, your email will remain in an unconfirmed state. This means you won't be able to take advantage of certain account features, such as requesting your post archive or taking advantage of security features like login verification.
